label:
3. Oops, sorry! I just noticed your messages.
Yee…

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text:
Oops, sorry! I just noticed your messages.
Yeesh, there are so many...
Sorry again.
I'll try and check my message more often.
Don't worry about it.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: My good fellow, hast thou arrived in the Ark?
Yes. I'm here safe and sound, thanks to Rapunzel.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: :p

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Well done!

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: At long last, the knights of the round have all gathered in one locale!

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: We must all drink and be merry!

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Scarlet, are you drinking already?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Isn't your destination really far out?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I didn't expect you to arrive so quickly.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: What is that?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Alas, I have yet to arrive!
So you're drinking on the move?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Indeed! Ye truly understand me, right to mine core.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: With weather as splendid as this

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: one simply must imbibe!

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Did I not tell you last time? Drink somewhere safe.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Indeed, thou speakest the truth.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: But one cannot so easily resist the temptation of such fine weather!

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: The finer the weather, the bigger the pour!

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Speaking of, I must fetch another cup.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Until we meet again, my friends.
See you :|

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text:
Fine.
Try and stay alive until then, all of you.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Take care of yourselves, guys!
